canon: Criatura flaca de cuatro patas, pelaje rojizo rasposo, mechones de pelo negro en los tobillos y patas desproporcionadamente largas; pelaje enredado con parches de arena fosilizada que brillan como vetas minerales rojas, hilera de púas oscuras erizadas en el lomo, colmillos curvos amarillentos exagerados, costillas marcadas, cola negra tupida que borra sus huellas.
fuentes: backend/src/scripts/worldCatalog.ts:1479 (bio); backend/src/services/sexDimorphism.ts:99-111 (dimorfismo); detalle campo a campo en docs/producto/plan-imagenes/borradores/fichas-piloto.json

prompt.sujeto: A lean, long-legged pack hunter with a narrow deep chest, a sloping back and disproportionately long, thin legs, standing about as high as an adult orc's hip.
prompt.ancla: a maned wolf, only gaunter and wilder
prompt.cuerpo: Its ribs show beneath tight skin, tufts of black hair ring its ankles, and its long dark muzzle carries oversized, curved, yellowish fangs. The rough, tangled coat is a dull rust red with darker underparts and amber eyes.
rasgos: Thin glinting streaks of red mineral are embedded in the coat along the flanks like veins of ore.
A ridge of dark bristling spines runs down its back to the tail.
Its thick black tail drags behind it, brushing away its own tracks.
prompt.pose: It crouches low and stalks through the tall grass, with two more of the pack behind it.
prompt.entorno: Around them lie red clay and tall straw-yellow grass tinged with orange.

rasgos+: This male has a thick, bristling ruff around the neck and pale healed streaks across the muzzle.

hembra.sujeto: A lean, long-legged pack hunter with a narrow deep chest, a sloping back and disproportionately long, thin legs, standing about as high as an adult orc's mid-thigh.
rasgos+: This female has a smooth, sleek neck and especially long legs for her slender body.
hembra.pose: She crouches low at the front of the stalking pack, with two more of the pack behind her.

propuestas: paleta: rust red, darker underparts, amber eyes, dark muzzle
escala: hip / mid-thigh of an adult orc
pose: crouching, two more of the pack
